title: Under "it's polyhedra week": a 274-follower account's declaration, the replies beneath it, and a second week declared the same evening
summary: On Mon 16 Nov 18:35Z @oscillatory.net (274 followers) quote-posted a link bot's item about "nopert polyhedra" with the words "it's polyhedra week" (15 likes). The digest's table of week declarations (Appendix D) gives this as the first use of "polyhedra week": 3 people, 5 posts in the window. Six minutes later @gracekind.net replied "@norvid-studies.bsky.social let's get it trending". On Tue 17 Nov 16:00Z, one minute after posting a video of instruments made of polyhedra (the digest's story 2), @yonderdavid.bsky.social replied in that same thread: "Perfect, I had about three hundred thousand mostly regular polyhedra lying around and needed something to do with them." Also under the declaration, @oszillate.bsky.social (75 followers) and @oscillatory.net exchanged three posts about the Rupert property (whether a solid can pass through a hole cut in a copy of itself) for the regular tetrahedron: one considered digging "an origami tetrahedron from storage" to check, the other "had to find a blog post", and the first then reported working it out. Separately, 54 minutes after the declaration, @lucresnooker.bsky.social (498 followers) posted "GAR WEEK GAR WEEK GAR WEEK THIS IS NOT A DRILL", quoting an outside account's announcement of Gar Week 2026; Appendix D lists "gar week" as a declared week too (1 person, 1 post). The talk lane's card talk-polyhedra-week covers the week as a whole and includes the declaration; this card is the thread under it.

posts.text: I did end up working out that there must be an arrangement in which the outline is triangular but all edges are at an angle, thus all of them project to something shorter; which then clearly means it fits just slightly inside one face.

sensitive: Two different accounts with similar handles appear in the polyhedra cards: @oscillatory.net (display name "a hangry mouse", 274 followers) and @oszillate.bsky.social (display name "*Pistäwəńćə", 75 followers). They are not the same person. @oszillate.bsky.social is on four cards in this lane and @oscillatory.net on three, which is a lot of attention for accounts this small (R7; variety in people). Both are small or near-small accounts (R7: only as the hero of a moment). The digest's phrase table credits @oscillatory.net with the window's first use of "polyhedra" on Fri 13 Nov; that post uses a jokey mental-health word and sits in flagged story 28, so it is left out here (R10). @gracekind.net was shown in the previous episode (featuredPrevious: shown). The gar week post is about an outside event, quoted from an account outside the cluster; I know nothing about Gar Week beyond the quoted post. Other posts in the window by @oszillate.bsky.social and @lucresnooker.bsky.social are personal or political and are not used.
